'''Elrood''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located between the [[Halbara system/Legends|Halbara]] and [[Kidron system/Legends|Kidron]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] on the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]]. It functioned as [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and as its major trade and manufacturing hub. Elrood headquartered [[Radell Mining Corporation]], the largest company in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], [[Sharene]] and [[Lodos (moon)|Lodos]]. The planet was named after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Elrood (senator)|Elrood]], who secured funding for its colonization.

==Geography==
Elrood had three main continents; its capital, [[Elrooden]], was located on the western half of the largest continent. The climate of Elrood was pleasant, and its resources, flora, and fauna made it an attractive target for colonists despite its location in the isolated [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].

Elrood's four Imperial-class [[Spaceport/Legends|starports]] were renowned for their immaculate cleanliness and strict regulations. Armor and all ranged weapons were prohibited on Elrood, and non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creatures could not leave a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] unless leashed.<ref name="PotG3" />

==History==
The world was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[8000 BBY]]. Elrood supported the Republic out of loyalty to its origins.

Following its initial colonization, Elrood developed slowly due to its lack of large mineral deposits. Elroodians enjoyed a quiet, agrarian lifestyle as its population slowly grew.<ref name="PotG3" /> Following first contact with some of the Elrood sector's native sentients (the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynites]], [[Orfite]]s, [[Meri]], and [[Teltior]]s), Elrood grew to prominence in the sector but remained essentially unchanged.

With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Elroodians generally trusted [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] motivations and promised reforms. In time, however, the Empire's tendency to favor megacorporations instead of smaller regional interests like those of Elrood sector led to some misgivings among Elrood's people&mdash;but not enough for them to develop sympathy for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which was seen as a dangerous and misguided revolutionary movement.<ref name="PotG3" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Elrood was the site of a commercial colony containing prefabricated room units from the factories of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].

The [[Ganrite Yards of Elrood, Inc.|Ganrite Yards of Elrood]] were based on the planet.

[[Durrei]] was a native of Elrood.
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 6]] misspells the planet as ''Eldrood''.

The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Elrood in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
